prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct on-camera hard flash with bright facial highlights and hard shadows behind the subjects, cold flash balance, visible digital noise, raw amateur snapshot mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone flash capture, vertical 9:16, high ISO, fast shutter, sharp facial and fur detail, authentic unedited texture.
